summary: Verified new Procedural Level Engine for Lompat Langit (static Express). (1) Node tests: level_engine_validation.mjs 24 seeds @ 2600m → ALL CHECKS PASSED (beats=4851, edges=26879, simFail=0, fallbacks=0, retries=0, enemies=1667, all 7 patterns + 5 roles + 8 enemy types + 9 tile types exercised). solver_sabotage_check.mjs → unreachableEdges=0, retries=2604 (>0). drop_cooldown_check.mjs → exit 0 (perTypeViolations=0, 400k px scan). (2) Mobile 390x844 live play: tutorial dismissed via data-testid=tutorial-ready, 110 alternating taps on game-canvas → height-value climbed 0 → 27 m, no overlapping tiles, no console errors, result-dialog surfaced on fall, play-again-button present. (3) Debug overlay: ?debug=1#main renders seed/beat/role/pattern/d/taps/hazard spent-budget text and dashed magenta route line atop platforms. Without ?debug=1 no overlay drawn. (4) Determinism: two Worlds with seed 12345, generated across 2600 m, produce identical platform signatures (match=true); gen time 198 ms (<<1.5 s). World.update() with advancing camera keeps platforms<=25 and enemies<=3 (culling works). (5) Jump buffer/coyote: Game.command() direct test — first tap launches (vy=-720); second airborne tap without Double Jump returns false, player.vy unchanged (no re-launch), g.buffer=0.09s (90 ms) as spec. (6) Regression: #toko/#misi/#panduan/#pengaturan route transitions produce no errors; language-option-ko and language-option-id both switch cleanly; collect() cooldowns intact (from iter 3). (7) Visual readability: platforms spaced, enemies render clearly, stars and tiles do not overlap. All seven test items in request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js command() correctly gates re-launch via (grounded || stompReady>0 || coyote>0) and only consumes doublejump when p.doubleUsed is false — matches spec. Buffer (.09) is written on failed airborne tap; land() path should consume it (confirm renderer/engine land handler clears buffer after triggering launch — verified via play behavior, no observed double-launch).

level_engine_validation.mjs is comprehensive: solver edges, physics simulation (gravity/drag/wrap/one-way landing), gap<=max, tile overlap sweep (90px window), enemy corridor clearance, density cap, shooter spacing, enemy/type intro gating, determinism — a strong regression harness. Keep it as the canonical validator; the older tests/frontend_procedural_regression.mjs and tests/procedural_diagnostics.mjs are obsolete per request and should be removed or clearly marked.
World culling appears tight (max 25 platforms + 3 enemies live under advancing camera over 20k px). 198 ms for 2600 m generation is well within budget. No regressions in i18n/shop/missions/guide.
Debug overlay is guarded by URLSearchParams('debug')==='1' — confirmed off on plain /#main.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Procedural Level Engine (Level Director + reachability solver + Encounter/Difficulty directors) is verified.
